commands.full: JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=20 EXECUTABLE > full.csv; final repeat: just bench > final-repeat.csv
commands.paired: For each paired-filters.json entry, run final then M18, JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=300, JX_BENCH_FILTER=name and JX_BENCH_BYTES=size. Concatenate under one CSV header.
commands.capacity: Before then after UTF-16 lower-bound reservations, then reverse order; JX_BENCH_FILTER=helper JX_BENCH_BYTES=500, and helper/uri_roundtrip plus helper/base64_roundtrip at 1048586 bytes; 300 ms.
commands.scanner: For scanner-filters.json, before then static scanner diagnostics; reverse order for scanner-reverse files. 300 ms.
commands.map: JX_BENCH_FILTER=builtin/map_builtin JX_BENCH_BYTES=100 JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=500 EXECUTABLE. Order final/M18/before-scanner then before-scanner/M18/final.
commands.profile: Same map filter with 1000 ms; after sample 0 prints, /usr/bin/sample PID 3 1 -file PROFILE. Profiled timings are excluded.
commands.frames: otool -tV EXECUTABLE; retain exact non-generic symbols ending Node3run/Scanner5value/Scanner6string and prologues.
commands.inventory: python3 scripts/probe-conformance.py UPSTREAM CLI observations.json; add --remaining to observe only unclassified rows. Reviewed manifest controls the complete importer.

notes: M18 release benchmark and CLI copied before any M19 changes; no source dependency on that binary. Rebuild baseline_commit in an isolated checkout to reproduce.

The final engine adds thirteen fixed builtins, comments/Unicode names, grouping-boundary syntax checks, static-round folding and stack-frame separation. No new value/context variant, function runtime, input cache or execution-plan instruction.
base64 0.22.1 is the only new production dependency, supplying the binary codec. URI compatibility and Node binary-string conversion remain explicit small adapters.

capacity pairs precede the scanner change and final static-round/harness additions; these additions do not execute in the paired URI/base64 subjects. Reverse retained-string-capacity.diff on final source to replay the earlier capacity policy.

scanner pairs precede final static-round/harness additions, which do not execute in their subjects. Reverse retained-scanner-diagnostics.diff on final source to replay the public-error scanner. Both retained patches show final source changes relative to M18.

Scanner-only static errors avoid drop-bearing owned-message errors inside recursive traversal; successful results/validation grammar are unchanged. Paired nested-fold gain is about 4-5%, allocations unchanged.

Map reaches 2.15-2.17M records/s in both final full runs, but 1.58-1.62M/s in isolated final repeats versus about 2.00M/s in M18. Both-order samples preserve the discrepancy. Profiles locate existing scanner/signature/value routines, not a new runtime feature, and do not isolate a cause. No speculative layout tuning retained.

All 1679 language cases/102 groups are classified. Blockers and recursion guards assert local failures, not upstream success. The upstream JS embedding/async/parser-recovery suites are outside this language corpus.
